openStreetMap.note: Use an allowed tile provider or self-hosted tiles for production/bulk/offline use.

openSeaMap.note: Attribute OpenSeaMap/OpenStreetMap and follow tile/data terms.

gebco.note: Official GEBCO WMS; current service is based on GEBCO 2026.

carto.note: Public tiles are subject to CARTO service terms and attribution.

avenzaStyleOffline.note: Only use maps/data for which the user or operator has rights.

radar.note: A phone cannot become a physical marine radar through software alone.

batnas.note: Enable only after authorized dataset access is confirmed.

bmkg.note: Automated access must use the official API. Commercial third-party integration requires written permission.
